rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved, provided or sponsored by the ADHA, AGD or ADA; board-approved courses from dental or dental hygiene schools or organizations; board-approved study clubs and self-study
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: half the required contact hours for each complete year licensed in the concluding period, plus current CPR certification.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement of compliance on the renewal form; keep detailed CE records and produce them on request (12 AAC 02.960 audit).
rules.notes: Current hands-on CPR certification required; max 4 CPR hours count. Restorative function endorsement: +2 h on restorative materials/techniques. Practice/risk management max 3 h; volunteer max 2 h; internet CE max 8 h per 24-hour period.
rules.rule_quote: (b) Except as provided in 12 AAC 28.405(b), an applicant for renewal of a dental hygienist license shall submit evidence of continued professional competence by documenting (1) completion of at least 20 contact hours of continuing education;

topics.who: Current hands-on CPR; max 4 CPR hours count; also at first renewal
